media.publicCaption: Carl Meinhard (also Karl Meinhardt), Austrian actor and theatre director, in a portrait published in Berliner Leben in 1908.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unidentified; Berliner Leben, no. 9 (1908); Wikimedia Commons.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. Wikimedia Commons identifies the photograph as published in Berliner Leben in 1908 or earlier, credits an unidentified photographer and marks it free of known copyright restrictions (Public Domain Mark 1.0). It is also public domain in the United States because it was published before 1931.

personNameVariants.publicNote: The printed credit on “Hochzeitsreise zu Dritt”, together with the VIAF cluster and GND record, gives Carl Meinhard. “Karl Meinhardt” is a Germanised variant.
